title: Always Beachy | 4BR Vacation Condo Dune Allen Beach | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Always Beachy is a 4BR Gulf front condo in Dune Allen Beach 30A with top floor Gulf views and Gulf Place dining steps away. Reserve with Royal Destinations!
description_expanded: Description: Always Beachy on 30A by Royal Destinations Address: 4451 W County Highway 30A, Ste A-401, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Location: Dune Allen Beach Details: Always Beachy, nestled within Santa Rosa Beach Villas, is the ultimate 30A getaway. As you drive through the gates of these Gulf-front condo-style villas, you’ll be greeted by breathtaking, unobstructed views stretching endlessly before you. To the south, the emerald waters and pristine white sand beaches—both private and public—create a stunning coastal backdrop. To the north, Gulf Place offers a vibrant mix of restaurants, shops, live music, and warm southern hospitality. Perched on the top floor, this tropical-inspired retreat is accessible by stairs or elevator. Step inside, and you may never want to leave. The spacious covered porch provides the perfect spot to soak in the spectacular sunsets—an unforgettable highlight of your stay. Plus, with The Shops at Gulf Place, Pizza By The Sea, Shunk Gulley, and Papa Surf Burger Bar just across the street, everything you need is within easy reach. Always Beachy is more than just a vacation spot—it’s a place where cherished family memories are made. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front - Large Community Pool - Updates Made Winter Of 2024 - Directly Across From The Shops at Gulf Place, Pizza By The Sea, Shunk Gulley, and Papa Surf Burger Bar (Great shopping and dining options!) - Parking Spaces: 2 - Dining Accommodations: 6 at Dining Table – 4 Bar - 4 Outside - Wood Floors In All Bedrooms Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 8 4 Bedrooms / 3 Full Baths One Floor: - Guest Room 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub/Shower) - Guest Room 2: Queen Bed with Private Bath - Guest Room 3: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) - Guest Room 4: Two Twin Beds Shared Bath (Shower) - Kitchen / Living / Dining Amenities: -Beach Towel Service Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Fireplace Is Not for Guest Use *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
